taste.name: One bespoke typeface for every role
taste.trigger: When a city portal needed to feel like Dubai in Arabic and English
taste.decision: Chose the custom 'Dubai' font for all text over a display/body pairing
taste.reason: One family that covers both scripts keeps the bilingual switch visually seamless and makes the brand recognisable from type alone

taste.name: Service search first, over the scenery
taste.trigger: When the hero had to serve both tourists and residents
taste.decision: Chose a centred search bar and 'Explore Dubai Services' link on top of a full-bleed video over a marketing headline
taste.reason: Most visitors arrive to do a task. Putting search in the hero shortens the path to it.
evidence: search input ~672px wide centred under the wordmark
persistent bottom utility bar: Services, Site Map, News Room, Contact Us

taste.name: Restraint: almost no accent colour
taste.trigger: When a city brand could have splashed a brand hue everywhere
taste.decision: Chose white, #F2F2F2 and #272833 with only a blue #0056CC link colour over a coloured UI chrome
taste.reason: The photography supplies the colour. Neutral chrome keeps task UI legible on top of it.
